title: Concept: External program executed from a command line in pascal — review required
description: In pascal, a program is launched from a single command-line string. The string is parsed by the platform, so quoting and separator rules decide where the executable ends and arguments begin; input containing spaces or quotes changes that split. Passing arguments as a list removes the ambiguity.
applicability: pascal desktop tools and service helpers.
risk: Execution of unintended programs or arguments; HIGH severity.
